name: The Ritz Carlton Bahrain Hotel & Spa
positioning: Beachfront hotel in Manama with a private lagoon, a private island and a Royal Beach Club; the official name is The Ritz-Carlton, Bahrain
best_for: Travelers who want a private beach, a spa and a hammam in Manama
Families with children aged 4 to 12 who can use Ritz Kids

facts.text: The hotel spans 70 acres of private beachfront around a lagoon in Manama.
The Royal Beach Club offers access to a private beach, lagoon and marina.
The three-bedroom villas have direct beach access and a private pool.
The Club Level is on the 6th and 7th floors and is described as a hotel within a hotel.
The Club Lounge offers complimentary food and beverage presentations five times each day.
Nirvana is a fine dining Indian restaurant with kebabs, grilled seafood and live traditional music.
Cantina Kahlo is a Mexican restaurant with decor inspired by Mexico's art scene.
Plums is a modern steakhouse whose specialties are premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood.
Afternoon tea is served daily in the Lobby Lounge, with a classical duo playing.
The spa uses Dead Sea minerals and has a thalassotherapy pool.
The Royal Beach Club has a Turkish hammam with four plunge pools at different temperatures.
Ritz Kids welcomes children aged 4 to 12 to join its activities.

highlights.text: Ta Plage Privée is on the resort's private island and offers an air-conditioned private tent, a dedicated massage room and an exclusive beach.
The three-bedroom villas have direct beach access and a private pool.
La Table Krug is described by the hotel as the region's first and smallest fine dining restaurant.
The spa uses Dead Sea minerals and has a thalassotherapy pool.
The resort's Pearl 1 boat runs daily sea excursions along the coast, including dolphin watching.

considerations.text: The minimum age to enter the spa is 16.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not give complimentary Club access.
During Ramadan, the hotel's restaurant operations change.
